name: Teusajaure-Vakkotavare
estimatedTime: 4-6 hours by STF; 5-6 or 5-7 hours in other official/secondary evidence

difficulty.label: Moderate mountain stage because of boat logistics and elevation change despite straightforward trail
difficulty.source: STF and Naturkartan describe the route as generally straightforward after a required Teusajaure crossing, with a long climb from birch forest to open fell/heath and a steep switchbacking descent to Vakkotavare. Field reports stress rowing effort, mud/high terrain in places and a steep/slippery final descent.
caveats: The Teusajaure lake crossing can be physically hard when self-rowing and may be unsafe or cancelled in wind or unsuitable water levels.
Time estimates conflict: STF route evidence says 4-6 hours, Naturkartan says 5-6 hours and an STF English snippet/secondary guides may show 5-7 hours.
The section ends at a roadhead, but Vakkotavare has no shop/resupply according to current STF route and shop-list evidence.

notes: Official direction is Teusajaure to Vakkotavare.
The section begins with the Dievssajavri/Teusajaure boat or rowboat crossing from the hut/north shore to the south landing.
The walking portion after the crossing enters Stora Sjofallet/Stuor Muorkke National Park within Laponia World Heritage.
Southbound continuation after Vakkotavare is a road/bus and Kebnats-Saltoluokta boat transfer before the next mapped walking stage at Saltoluokta.

rules: National park rules prohibit intentionally disturbing grazing reindeer or reindeer gathering/driving.
National park rules prohibit disturbing/killing wildlife, damaging vegetation/geology and littering.
Hunting and fishing are prohibited for visitors inside the national park. Do not infer legal fishing near Vakkotavare/Akkajaure without exact boundary and permit checks.
Dogs are generally restricted, but leashed dogs are allowed year-round when travelling on Kungsleden in Stora Sjofallet/Stuor Muorkke; leashed dogs are also allowed 1 January-30 April generally.
Cycling, riding/bringing horses and motorized terrain travel are restricted under park regulations.
Picking berries and edible mushrooms is allowed.
Drones are treated under aircraft restrictions; takeoff/landing requires county permission under national-park rules, and Laponia guidance is stricter.
Short tenting for a day or two is allowed under official overnight guidance, but follow reindeer/herding, vegetation and litter restrictions.
safetyNotes: Teusajaure crossing can be hard or unsafe in wind; motorboat can be cancelled in severe weather or unsuitable water levels.
If self-rowing and only one boat is on your side, three crossings may be needed to leave one boat on each shore.
Long climb after crossing, then open fell/heath exposure and a steep switchbacking descent to Vakkotavare.
Field reports describe muddy high terrain and steep rocky/slippery final descent.
No recent section-specific bridge closure/reroute was found as of 2026-04-29.
Cell coverage may be absent at Teusajaure; STF Vakkotavare reports generally Telia GSM coverage but should not be relied on for safety.
currentness: No section-specific bridge closure/reroute found in Lansstyrelsen current Norrbotten mountain-trail notices as of 2026-04-29.

Lansstyrelsen 2026-04-22 and 2026-03-27 notices warn about spring/winter snow and ice hazards, stopped winter-route checks and weak ice; these are not summer closures but matter early/shoulder season.
STF Teusajaure and Vakkotavare 2026 summer opening reported as 2026-06-18 to 2026-09-13; winter/spring opening was 2026-02-27 to 2026-04-19.
STF boat page accessed 2026-04-29 still carried 2025 update/dates and listed Teusajaure service through September 14, one day beyond 2026 hut closing date. Recheck before relying on it.
Road to Ritsem 2026 timetable is affected by planned rail works and exact travel-day bookings should be checked.

Describes final descent as one of the steepest/slipperiest on Kungsleden.
